title: find Phil Flash in Seattle 🎨
description:
## the OG bounty

inspired by this IG post: https://www.instagram.com/reels/Dd-VLgVBJwC/

"$100 THRIFT BOUNTY 🖼️ I’ll pay $100 to the FIRST person who finds a painting by my grandfather, Phil Flash.

He usually signed his paintings “Flash” with a backwards F. If you’re digging through art at a thrift store or estate sale, keep an eye out for that signature.

Spot one? DM me a photo of the painting and signature. I’d love to track down more of his work.

Send this to your friend who’s always thrifting 👀"

## the poidh bounty

the ask is simple: claim @cascadeexcursions' Instagram bounty, and you can claim this bounty

once they've confirmed you as the winner and awarded the original $100 prize, you can submit a claim on this page to collect the side prize (any ETH pooled here)

please include proof that you won the original bounty, ideally a public IG post from @cascadeexcursions confirming your win, or screenshots of your correspondence with them

first legit claim wins! 

deadline to submit a claim is November 15th @ 11:59pm PST

comments.body: nvm @cascadeexcursions requested that the bounty come down 😔
